# Human Protocol Surface Candidate License Audit

Generated: 2026-06-18T03:06:01.920Z

Scope: downloaded preview candidates. Wall, floor, and ceiling textures are adapted into the /build environment material registry and WebGPU runtime-pack surface overrides; door candidates remain raw references until gameplay door collision/animation/style are designed.

## Source License Summary

- ambientCG: CC0 1.0 Universal. Official license states assets may be copied, modified, distributed, used commercially, and raw files may be included in a video game.
- Poly Haven: CC0. Official license states assets may be used commercially, need no attribution, and may be redistributed/included in a product.

## Integration Notes

- Wall candidates now keep Bricks097 and add industrial metal/concrete options plus two museum gallery surfaces.
- Ceiling candidates no longer use OfficeCeiling; the visible registry uses industrial metal/concrete options plus two museum gallery surfaces.
- `/build` exposes floor, wall, and ceiling in the same Environment Materials catalog tab. Shift or the Continuous toggle keeps the material brush armed for whole-room surface painting.
- Builder runtime packs consume each selected preset through `roomSurfaceTextureOverride`, so WebGPU playtests use the same base-color texture instead of a separate hand-maintained render-plan patch.
- Door candidates are not registered as official gameplay doors yet.
